{{Top|leg}}
A '''Stuicer''' was a fruit that grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]. It was bulblike, and its juice was sipped through a thin tube near the top.<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>
